description: Web page extract: Fetches one public web page and returns title, meta description, canonical URL, language, h1-h3 headings, link and word counts, and the visible text as clean Markdown-style plain text (scripts, styles, navigation and footers removed; capped at 60 kB). Static HTML only. Source: the page itself. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: title, description, canonical, language, headings[{level, text}], link_count, word_count, text, text_truncated.
name: x420_web_page-extract
